roles._layout: Main bars repeat in cycles along the culvert: CYCLE-1 and CYCLE-3 (mirror images, T1<->T3 and B2<->B4 swapped) and CYCLE-2,4. Cycle pitch = 4 x the main-bar spacing (@600 when slabs are @150, @500 when @125). Per-metre counts in the bar table (3.33/6.67 for @150 drawings, 4/8 for @125) follow from this. 'Outer face' = soil side, 'inner face' = cell side.
roles.T1: CYCLE-1/3: top slab outer (top) face, left piece; L-shaped, bent down into the left side wall outer face (corner bar)
roles.T2: CYCLE-1/3: top slab outer (top) face, centre piece spanning over the middle wall (negative-moment bar), lapped with T1/T3
roles.T3: CYCLE-1/3: top slab outer (top) face, right piece; bent down into the right side wall outer face (mirror of T1)
roles.T4: CYCLE-1/3: top slab inner (bottom/cell) face, one continuous bar across both cells (length ~ total width - covers)
roles.T5: CYCLE-2,4: top slab outer face, left end piece bent down into left side wall outer face
roles.T6: CYCLE-2,4: top slab outer face, centre straight piece over the middle wall
roles.T7: CYCLE-2,4: top slab outer face, right end piece bent down into right side wall outer face
roles.T8: CYCLE-2,4: top slab inner (bottom) face continuous bar across both cells (shorter than T4)
roles.B1: CYCLE-1/3: bottom slab inner (top/cell) face, continuous across both cells
roles.B2: CYCLE-1/3: bottom slab outer (bottom) face, left piece bent up into left side wall outer face
roles.B3: CYCLE-1/3: bottom slab outer (bottom) face, centre piece under the middle wall
roles.B4: CYCLE-1/3: bottom slab outer (bottom) face, right piece bent up into right side wall outer face
roles.B5: CYCLE-2,4: bottom slab inner (top) face continuous bar across both cells
roles.B6: CYCLE-2,4: bottom slab outer face, left end piece bent up into left side wall
roles.B7: CYCLE-2,4: bottom slab outer face, centre straight piece under the middle wall
roles.B8: CYCLE-2,4: bottom slab outer face, right end piece bent up into right side wall
roles.W1: CYCLE-1/3: left side wall inner (cell) face vertical bar, hooked into top and bottom slabs (측벽 내측 @2x outer spacing)
roles.W2: CYCLE-1/3: right side wall inner face vertical bar (mirror of W1, same length)
roles.O1: CYCLE-1/3: middle wall (내벽) vertical bar, both faces, anchored into top and bottom slabs (L ~ H + tT + tB + hooks)
roles.H1: top haunch diagonal bar (bent both ends 135 deg, shape a/b) across a top inner corner; with H2 covers the 4 top inner corners (side-wall corners and middle-wall corners); H1 slightly longer than H2
roles.H2: top haunch diagonal bar at the other pair of top inner corners (see H1)
roles.H3: bottom inner-corner diagonal bar (bottom corners have no haunch in H2 series, so these are shorter corner bars); with H4 covers the 4 bottom inner corners
roles.H4: bottom inner-corner diagonal bar at the other pair of bottom inner corners (see H3)
roles.R1: outer (exterior) corner reinforcement at the top slab/side wall junction: short bar bent 135 deg at both ends (b=300) placed across the outside corner inside T1/T3; first appears in H2-9
roles.R2: outer corner reinforcement at the bottom slab/side wall junction (same shape as R1); appears only in some drawings
roles.D1: longitudinal distribution bars of the top slab (both faces), length ~1.05-1.08 m per 1 m run
roles.D2: longitudinal distribution bars of the bottom slab (both faces)
roles.D3: longitudinal distribution bars of the side walls (both faces)
roles.D4: longitudinal distribution bars of the middle wall (both faces)
roles.S1: shear/spacer tie (hooked U, a = slab thickness - covers, b=100) in the top slab
roles.S2: shear/spacer tie in the bottom slab (a grows with tB)
roles.S3: shear/spacer tie in the side walls (a grows with tW)
roles.S4: tie in the middle wall (open U shape a/b/c, b spans the middle-wall thickness; grows by 200 mm when tM goes 300->400)
roles._mark_changes: Same mark set (T1-T8, B1-B8, W1-W2, O1, H1-H4, D1-D4, S1-S4) in all 45 drawings. R1 appears in H2-9..H2-45 except H2-12, H2-13, H2-15; R2 only in H2-9,10,18,19,27,28,29,30,32,36,37,38,39,40,42,43,44,45. Diameters vary per drawing (e.g. D1/D2 become H16 for large sections, B3/R bars go up to H22/H25).
